title: On Analysing the soil from three fields
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：analyse　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 analyse 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the keeper ① analysed the soil from three fields on the same day, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② analyses the soil from three fields before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ analyse the soil from three fields at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ analysed the soil from three fields before — a line in the calendar for January 1979 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Analysing the soil from three fields on the same day, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ analyse the way the boys argued before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Analyse the way the boys argued at once and never mention it again.

By 1992 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ analyses the way the boys argued on the same day every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ analysed the soil from three fields again when nobody else would.

⑩ To analyse the soil from three fields, my mother said in 1997, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody analyses the soil from three fields before dawn again and somebody must analyse the soil from three fields on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 分析（一般过去式 analysed the soil from three fields：1985 年守夜人头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 分析（一般现在 analyses the soil from three fields：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 分析（不定式 to analyse the soil from three fields：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 分析（过去完成时 had analysed the soil from three fields：1979 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 分析（动名词 analysing the soil from three fields 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 化验（analyse the way the boys argued：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去化验孩子们争论的方式）
G. v. 化验（analyse the way the boys argued：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 分析（后段两处：新来的过路人照例 analyses the way the boys argued，而母亲又一次 analysed the soil from three fields）

items.q: analysed the soil from three fields
analyses the soil from three fields
to analyse the soil from three fields
analysed the soil from three fields before
analysing the soil from three fields
analyse the way the boys argued before dawn
analyse the way the boys argued at once
analyses the way the boys argued on the same day
analysed the soil from three fields again
to analyse the soil from three fields

answers.why: analyse 意为“分析”，1985 年守夜人当天就分析三块地里取来的土，那是钟楼里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 analysed。
analyse 意为“分析”，自那以后守夜人天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 analyses。
analyse 意为“分析”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯分析三块地里取来的土”，此处为不定式 to analyse the soil from three fields。
analyse 意为“分析”，年历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1992 年之前就有人分析过，故用过去完成时 had analysed。
analyse 意为“分析”，守夜人说“分析三块地里取来的土这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 analysing the soil from three fields 作主语。
analyse 意为“化验”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去化验孩子们争论的方式”，should ever 之后用原形 analyse the way the boys argued。
analyse 意为“化验”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻化验孩子们争论的方式（analyse the way the boys argued at once），以后再也不要提起。
analyse 意为“分析”，新来的过路人每个年头都照例化验孩子们争论的方式，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 analyses。
analyse 意为“分析”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就分析三块地里取来的土，用一般过去式 analysed 叙述。
analyse 意为“分析”，结尾那句是母亲 1997 年的话：要分析三块地里取来的土，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和钟楼记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1985 年，守夜人当天就分析三块地里取来的土；钟楼里每一个过路人都说这是头一回。（analysed the soil from three fields）
多年以后，守夜人仍天没亮就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（analyses the soil from three fields）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯分析三块地里取来的土这件事本身。（to analyse the soil from three fields）
早在 1979 年就有人分析三块地里取来的土，一月那天年历上的一行字就是证据。（had analysed the soil from three fields）
守夜人说过，当天就分析三块地里取来的土这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（analysing the soil from three fields 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻化验孩子们争论的方式，以后再也不要提起。（analyse the way the boys argued，祈使句）
answers: In 1985 the keeper analysed the soil from three fields on the same day, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the keeper still analyses the soil from three fields before dawn without being asked.
My mother said later that to analyse the soil from three fields at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had analysed the soil from three fields long before 1992, and the line in the calendar for January proves it.
Analysing the soil from three fields on the same day, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Analyse the way the boys argued at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 analyse 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1985 the keeper analysed the soil from three fields on the same day, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper analyses the soil from three fields before dawn whenever the tower asks.
Analysing the soil from three fields on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever analyse the way the boys argued before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower analyses the way the boys argued on the same day every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother analysed the soil from three fields again, and the tower remembered that half.
